description.intro: The adidas t-shirt of Liverpool 26 27 authentic represents Anfield's passion and history with a design inspired by the club's classic equipments during the eighties. This player version incorporates top-level technical materials and a premium finish designed for footballers looking for lightness, breathability and elite performance.
key_benefits: CLIMACOOL+: Advanced system that evacuates sweat to keep skin fresh and dry during play.
Player version: Same design and technology that professionals use.
Technical fabric: Promote ventilation and breathability.
Fitting: Fits the body for maximum performance.
